studyDescription: MRI Lumbo-Sacral Spine with Multiplanar T1, T2, and STIR sequences

findings.lumbarVertebrae: Normal lumbar lordosis maintained. Vertebral body heights and marrow signals within normal limits.
findings.l4_l5_disc: Mild diffuse disc bulge with posterior central annular tear causing mild indentation of the anterior thecal sac without significant neural foraminal compromise.
findings.l5_s1_disc: Normal disc height and signal. Bilateral exiting and traversing nerve roots appear unremarkable.
findings.spinalCord: Conus medullaris terminates at L1 level with normal signal intensity.

impression: Mild L4-L5 posterior disc protrusion with annular tear. No evidence of severe spinal canal or neural foraminal stenosis.
